name: baseten-catalog-kimi
note: Catalog-backed counterpart to baseten-thinking, which uses a synthetic model. This model object is a VERBATIM copy of baseten/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5 from the pi-ai 0.84.1 catalog (first release to ship baseten data, upstream a5f43bf8a/53fa77ccd). It pins the chatTemplateArgs + supportsUsageInStreaming shape that real shipped models actually carry -- {"enable_thinking":{"$var":"thinking.enabled"}} -- rather than the richer synthetic shape. Backend is dist: unlike baseten-thinking (src, unreleased at the time), this data IS released in 0.84.1 so the published build arbitrates it. Refresh this model object whenever the catalog is regenerated.
